name: lupus classification overview
title: Lupus classification by the 2019 EULAR/ACR criteria: an ANA of at least 1:80 is required to enter; then score the highest item in each of seven clinical and three immunologic domains, and 10 or more points with at least one clinical item classifies the patient as having SLE

root.title: SLE classification (2019 EULAR/ACR): ANA ≥ 1:80 to ENTER, then ≥ 10 POINTS
lines: count only the HIGHEST item per domain · need ≥ 1 clinical item · classification, not diagnosis
lecture's case: malar 6 + joints 6 + platelets 4 + anti-Sm 6 + low C3 and C4 4 = 26 → SLE

groups.title: CLINICAL domains: at least ONE needed

head: h

pts: synovitis in 2+ joints, or 2+ tender joints + 30 min of morning stiffness
